question: What is LoomWeaver VTT and how does it compare to a traditional Virtual Tabletop (Virtual Table Top)?
answer: LoomWeaver VTT (accessible at loom-weaver.com/vtt and vtt.loom-weaver.com) is an all-in-one 2D, 2.5D, and 3D Virtual Tabletop (VTT / virtual table top) and fantasy tabletop role playing game (TTRPG / table top role playing game) campaign manager. Unlike standalone VTTs that separate your fantasy table top battlemaps from your campaign wiki, LoomWeaver connects your 2D & 3D tactical combat map, 3D physics dice, Character Studio, World Atlas, and living campaign memory (The Loom) into one unified dark-fantasy workspace.

question: Which fantasy TTRPG and table top role playing game systems work with LoomWeaver VTT?
answer: LoomWeaver VTT supports D&D 5e (2014 & 2024 SRD), Pathfinder 2e, Vampire: The Masquerade V5, and custom fantasy TTRPG / fantasy tabletop worlds. Game Masters can build custom monster actions, spells, items, and character sheets for any table top role playing game.

question: Does LoomWeaver write my story or replace the Game Master?
answer: The Loom is designed to search established campaign canon and cite its sources. The optional Weave creates drafts for GM review. Missing evidence should be stated clearly; generated drafts do not decide canon.

question: Do my players have to pay for a subscription to join my Virtual Tabletop?
answer: No. Players join your table for 100% free via frictionless invite links. Players never need a subscription to use Character Studio sheets, move tokens on the 2.5D VTT, roll 3D dice, or query The Loom for memories their character has witnessed.

question: How does LoomWeaver protect GM secrets and per-player knowledge?
answer: The V2 requirements call for server-enforced campaign membership, note visibility, and per-player knowledge boundaries. These controls must be verified for each release; a hidden interface element is not an authorization control.

question: How does the 85/15 Creator Marketplace revenue split work?
answer: The planned creator marketplace uses an 85/15 creator revenue split. Publication, payment, entitlements, and importing are subject to the V2 release gates.

question: What are the official LoomWeaver TTRPG & VTT domains and studio tools?
answer: The official LoomWeaver TTRPG & Virtual Tabletop platform is hosted at https://loom-weaver.com and unites specialized web studios under one shared Single Sign-On account: LoomWeaver VTT (vtt.loom-weaver.com), LoomMaps Battlemap & World Atlas Builder (maps.loom-weaver.com), Effect Builder Studio for spell shaders (effectbuilder.loom-weaver.com), Action & Encounter Builder (actionbuilder.loom-weaver.com), and 3D Asset & Miniature Generator Studio (3dassets.loom-weaver.com and generator.loom-weaver.com).
